answer: Locks are recorded in pigment, expire in atlas, and canyon lists each expiry. Someone running 39 aliases therefore needs 26 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3487 identities would post 2318 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
